Meeting Notes
Tidy with AIPaste rough notes or a transcript. Bloom sorts them into topics, actions, decisions and notes. You check it before anything is created.

Each topic becomes a task and its points become subtasks. Type @name and a day like Thursday on a point to set who and when. Click the tag on a point to mark it as a decision or a note instead.

    Your company needs to approve BloomBoard

    Many companies let only their IT admin approve new apps for Microsoft 365. This is a one-time step: once your admin approves, everyone at your company can connect Outlook.

    1. Send the link below to your IT admin (or whoever manages Microsoft 365 at your company).
    2. They open it, sign in with their admin account and click Accept.
    3. Come back here and click Connect next to Microsoft again.
